profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
As a kid, I was always tinkering with something, curious about how things worked and how they were put together. If something didn’t quite meet my needs, I’d modify it to make it work better. Disassembling objects, analyzing products, and finding ways to optimize them became second nature. Fast forward to today, and not much has changed.

I’m eager to apply my skills to create innovative solutions and make a positive impact on the world.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Numerically Controlled (CNC) Machinist Technology/CNC Machinist
